description: Read a recorded House division, its full official tally, party totals, and a page of individual ballots. Ballot, personId, party, and province filters affect the ballot page only; nonvoters are absent. Omitted session means the verified current official session. Follow nextOffset with identical filters.

ballot.description: Recorded ballot Yea, Nay, or Paired, case-insensitive; Yes and No are accepted as Yea and Nay.

limit.description: Maximum returned ballots, 1–400 per call, default 30; larger values up to 10000 clamp to 400 with a notice. A page ends early at the 24000-byte response budget; follow nextOffset.

number.description: Division number returned by canparl_search_votes or canparl_get_bill.

offset.description: Zero-based offset in the selected ordering.

party.description: Canonical official caucus or certain Bloc/Green alias; historical observed caucuses are accepted.

personId.description: Decimal official person ID from canparl_search_members detailLookup or a ballot row; matches this division's recorded participants, including members no longer seated.

province.description: English province/territory name or one of the 13 postal codes.

name: canparl_get_vote

appliedFilters.description: Normalized ballot filters and division identity.

personId.description: Official person ID filter, or null.

ballots.description: Matching ballots ordered by caucus, surname, given name, then personId.

ballot.description: Recorded ballot; no inferred nonvoter rows.

byParty.description: Complete unfiltered participant aggregation by source caucus.

items.description: Unfiltered recorded ballots for one source caucus.

party.description: Source caucus, or null for unknown.

total.description: Total recorded ballots for this caucus.

cap.description: Effective ballot page limit after the per-call cap.

billCode.description: Linked canonical bill code, or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unsupported_vote_session`: Malformed or unsupported official division session. `vote_not_found`: Division absent from session feed or explicit detail 404. `invalid_ballot_filter`: Unrecognized caucus, province, or ballot value, or a personId that is not decimal. `vote_detail_unavailable`: A listed division has empty participant detail. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Limit clamp, nonvoter, mismatch, empty, past-end, or response-budget guidance.

pagination.description: Continuation within matching ballots; nextOffset is offset plus ballots returned.

limit.description: Effective maximum rows after the per-call cap.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, or null when exhausted.

provenance.description: Retrieval metadata for every source request.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

tally.description: Official counts independent of local filters.

tallyMatchesBallots.description: Whether all three official counts match participants; null if any count is absent.

truncated.description: Whether more matching ballots remain, including after a response-budget stop.

title: Canparl Get Vote
